name: Ricardo Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's path to motorsport finance wasn't typical. He initially studied engineering, but a summer job crunching numbers for a local racing team ignited a passion for the financial side of the sport. He quickly realized his aptitude for identifying inefficiencies and maximizing budgets. After earning his MBA, he worked for several smaller teams, honing his skills in resource allocation and financial planning. 

Ricardo believes in a transparent and collaborative approach. He prioritizes clear communication with all departments, ensuring everyone understands the financial implications of their decisions. He's known for his ability to find creative solutions to budgetary challenges, often uncovering hidden savings and revenue opportunities. His ambition and keen eye for detail make him a valuable asset to any team aiming for sustainable success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left, slightly receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down financial insights.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a physical calculator for complex calculations, distrusting software.
